title: Consolidated release-notes series
description: One minor line's released versions, at release-notes/v<X>.<Y>.x.json. An operator hand-writes release-notes/v<X>.<Y>.<Z>.json for the release being cut; scripts/consolidate-release-notes.js folds that file into this one and scripts/generate-changelog-entry.js renders both into CHANGELOG.md. A release object here is exactly what a per-release file holds, minus the $schema pointer the wrapper carries once for the whole series.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file. Lets editors validate the JSON inline.

minor.description: The minor line this file holds, matching the file's basename (v<minor>.x.json). Every release listed belongs to it.

releases.description: Every released version of the line, newest first. The order is load-bearing: the CHANGELOG renders it as written, and a reader upgrading across several patches reads down the list.

version.description: Strict semver (digits and dots, no `v` prefix). Its major and minor match the wrapper's `minor`.

date.description: Release date (YYYY-MM-DD). Fixed once the version ships, so a rebuild of the CHANGELOG is reproducible.

headline.description: Single-line summary. No trailing punctuation. Starts with capital letter or backtick. Operator-facing, so the leak-vocabulary sweep rejects phase / sweep / tier / batch / group / slice numbering and AI-tooling names.

summary.description: Optional. 1-3 sentences expanding the headline. Ends with sentence punctuation.

title.description: Short item title. No trailing punctuation. Starts with letter or backtick.

body.description: Explanatory prose for the item. Ends with sentence punctuation.
